name: Terry Davis: Difference Between Heaven and Hell
aliases: the difference between heaven and hell is doing your work
you feel really shitty if you don't do your work
if you do your work it's fucking awesome
description: A smiling Terry Davis in a grey t-shirt sits on a porch next to his quote in typewriter text: "You know the secret, the difference between Heaven and Hell, is like, doing your work. You feel really shitty if you don't do your work, if you do your work, it's fuckin' awesome."
usage: Motivation to stop procrastinating and ship. Posted when someone is avoiding work, or after finally finishing it.
